articles.title: At least 8 dead, including 2 children, after building collapses in Brooklyn, officials say
articles.summary: At a press conference on Thursday afternoon, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani provided updates on the Brooklyn building collapse, saying that six adults and two children were among the eight people who died on Wednesday. Two of the adults who died were construction workers. “This has been a devastating evening and morning for our city,” Mamdani said. Mamdani also confirmed that 18 other people were injured, including 14 civilians and four firefighters. The vast majority of those injured and being treated at hospitals are in stable condition, with one person in critical condition. “I want to take a moment to remember those we have so senselessly lost. These were our friends and our neighbors, parents and children,” the mayor said. “Young families building their lives in our city and immigrants from Mexico, Colombia, Ecuador, Trinidad and beyond. Let us continue to hold close those who have been plunged into unimaginable grief and pray for a full and rapid recovery for every New Yorker injured.” Mamdani also thanked the first responders and construction workers who helped dig through the rubble to find survivors. “People are alive today because of their heroism yesterday,” he said. “Firefighters arrived on the scene in less than one minute after the 911 call first came in,” Mamdani added. The American Red Cross has opened a reception center at the Flatbush YMCA for residents who were affected and displaced by the building collapse. Mamdani said the city and American Red Cross will continue to provide “expanded services” from the Flatbush YMCA for residents displaced by the building collapse, including temporary housing, assistance with social services and mental health support. “Conditions will grow more challenging today with the rain, but operations will continue,” the mayor said. “A tragedy of this magnitude demands a comprehensive and thorough investigation that includes both the construction site and the building which collapsed. Mamdani said that the investigation has already begun, with law enforcement leading it. “There are five main entities involved with this construction site, or associated, with approximately 100 other sites across the city. Our Department of Buildings is commencing sweeps of those sites today.” This is a developing story. Check back for updates. Read the original story below. At least eight people died and 18 others were injured, when a three-story building collapsed Wednesday in the Flatbush neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York. The four-unit apartment building crumpled into a construction site next to it at about 4 p.m. ET. Those who were injured were taken to a hospital and included four in critical condition, officials said. Seven were children and three were firefighters. Authorities did not confirm if any children were among those killed. In a post on X Thursday morning , New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said, "Rescue workers have spent the night searching the site of yesterday's building collapse, working under extremely dangerous conditions to find and save anyone who may still be trapped. "I am heartbroken that eight New Yorkers have now lost their lives and at least 17 have been injured, including three firefighters. There are no words for a loss of this magnitude. My heart is with the families and loved ones of those we have lost, those who are injured and everyone grieving today." Two deaths were announced on Wednesday, with six further deaths confirmed Thursday. Water service was restored to about 100 buildings in the area on Thursday after the New York City Department of Environmental Protection had to shut down city water mains so that emergency crews could continue search and rescue operations, according to a post on X . Rescuers searched for survivors into the night with about 250 first responders working at the scene. "We'll continue to look until we find everybody," FDNY Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore said. A spokesperson for the FDNY told the New York Times Thursday that rescuers were still hoping to find survivors. A pregnant woman was among those pulled out of the rubble. Footage broadcast by CBS News New York showed her being taken away on a stretcher more than two hours after the building collapsed, while her husband waited in anguish. "She is alive. She is still alive. I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I thank all of you guys," he told CBS News New York after she was rescued. "She's pregnant, six months." The interiors of apartments in an adjacent damaged building were exposed after the building collapsed. Anadolu via Getty Images Earlier, the man had been seen frantically looking for her. "I've heard nothing. She's inside the building. She's pregnant," he told reporters. One resident, Anderson Velez, told the New York Post he was at work in the Bronx when his wife called him and said their children, ages 7 and 2, were trapped. "She called me when the building collapsed while she was inside with rubble on top of her. She was screaming for someone to help get my son out and then the call cut off," he said, confirming his family was now safe. An eyewitness, Melissa Orna, told the New York Times : "The whole building started shaking, and then it just fell." Where the building collapsed in Brooklyn. Anadolu via Getty Images The 1930s building fell into an adjoining construction site, where excavation work was ongoing. The cause of the collapse is under investigation, said John Esposito, the city's fire department chief. He said rescue teams may need to take several days to search the site for all potential victims. Officials have described the search and rescue mission as "very dangerous," with firefighters and police officers punching holes through rubble in the search of survivors. "Multiple people from the building and the construction site were trapped," Bonsignore said. "This will be a prolonged operation. Collapse operations are extremely dangerous. Every move is choreographed and critically important to patient outcomes and member safety. Members have been working methodically and haven't stopped since they arrived." No official cause for the collapse has been released. In April, the New York City Department of Buildings issued a violation to a demolition contractor at the construction site who "unlawfully continued work while on notice of a Stop Work Order," according to the violation. Inspectors noted that a single-story building was demolished despite the city's order to stop work. The violation was resolved in October, according to DOB records . Yahoo has requested comment from the DOB about why the city ordered a work stoppage in the first place. On Wednesday, DOB issued a full stop work order "due to unsafe construction operations causing adjacent building (1321 Flatbush Avenue) to collapse." First responders search through rubble and debris at the scene of a building collapse in Brooklyn, N.Y. Anadolu via Getty Images Mamdani said at a news conference Wednesday that rescue workers arrived on the scene within one minute of receiving the 911 call. He also confirmed some of the fatalities and said that injured people had been transported to local hospitals. "This has been an incredibly challenging and fast-moving situation — with precarious wreckage to navigate and dangerous voids beneath the surface," he said, adding, "This type of rescue is exactly what the FDNY trains for." He also asked New Yorkers to "please take a moment to pray for those who passed away today and all of those who are mourning their loss." articles.title: 1 dead, 4 wounded in a shooting in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle
articles.summary: At least five people were wounded and one was killed during a shooting in Washington, D.C.’s Logan Circle neighborhood early Thursday, police said. The gunman, who then barricaded himself inside an apartment building, later died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Officers responded to reports of an active shooting at a gym just before 8 a.m. ET, Metropolitan Police Department interim chief Jeffery Carroll said at a press briefing. Once inside, police located one victim, who died at the scene, Carroll said. Four others were wounded and transported to local hospitals. One of the victims was in critical condition, he said. Three had non-life-threatening injuries. As officers were clearing the gym and an adjacent building, shots rang out from the seventh floor, where the suspect barricaded himself inside an apartment, Carroll said. Much of the block was cordoned off, and nearby schools were placed on temporary lockdown. SWAT officers walk behind police tape at the scene of Thursday's shooting. AP Photo/Tom Brenner While police were attempting to negotiate with the barricaded suspect, he fatally shot himself, Carroll said. Police did not immediately identify the gunman. Carroll said that investigators believe the suspect had “some sort of conflict” with the apartment building’s homeowners association. While the suspect was barricaded, a fire broke out in the building, Carroll said. The building’s sprinkler system was activated, and the fire has since been extinguished, he said. Law enforcement officers are seen atop a building in Washington, D.C., on Thursday following reports of an active shooting. AP Photo/Julia Demaree Nikhinson James Spellman, who was at the gym, told the Associated Press that there were about 50 people there when the shooting began. "Within seconds there was a man who fell to the ground, and a pool of blood came out," Spellman said. "One gym member rushed to help him. He was instantly dead. He had been shot in the neck." Witness Ryan Dubicki said he was in his apartment around 8 a.m. when he "heard about five bangs." "They were really spread out so I thought it was construction," Dubicki told AP. His building's managers sent a notice about a possible active shooter. Another witness, Max Smith, told reporters that he heard gunshots and took shelter in a nearby shop.  "I'm very shaken up," Smith said. "You know, you don't expect it." The shootings, which occurred just a mile from the White House, prompted a massive law enforcement response. Federal agencies, including the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, said they sent agents to the scene to help. This is a breaking news story. Refresh this page for updates. articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as new affair allegations emerge
articles.summary: Nvidia ( NVDA ) stock tanked Thursday after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO . The company's CFO, Colette Kress, will serve as the interim head of the business until a permanent successor is named. Nvidia stock dropped 13% on the news before paring losses. The leadership shakeup followed a report from The New York Times on Wednesday that embattled Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang was allegedly involved in a second extramarital affair. The company's board was reportedly meeting on Wednesday night to determine if it will oust Huang as chief executive, the Wall Street Journal reports . According to the report, Huang, whose relationship with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy has embroiled the company in scandal this week, also had a relationship with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell. articles.title: A wintry forecast of snow expected to give way to warmer-than-average temperatures
articles.summary: Snow is likely to fall in the mountains of New York and northern New England Thursday night as a storm system — aka a developing nor'easter — currently dumping rain across the Mid-Atlantic moves north and encounters colder air from the north. The National Weather Service's Weather Prediction Center (WPC) said in its latest forecast that as the colder air wraps around the storm, rain will turn to snow overnight into Friday at higher elevations in New York, northeastern Pennsylvania and northern New England — likely making the roads hazardous. Those at lower elevations will mostly see rain through Thursday night, with a wintry mix possible Friday morning. Wet snow is also possible in the southern and central Appalachians, mainly from Friday night into Saturday morning — some areas could see their first snowflakes of the season. In Michigan's Upper Peninsula, heavy lake-effect snow will bring "significant accumulation" through Friday, the WPC said. The nor'easter is expected to strengthen as it moves into the Northeast through Thursday evening, after bringing scattered thunderstorms and gusty winds to the Ohio and Tennessee valleys earlier in the day. Its center is expected to pass east of Cape Cod. Steady rain is expected to spread over southern New England Thursday evening, possibly becoming heavy at times near the coast, according to the WPC, which also forecasts increasing northeasterly winds and minor coastal flooding around high tide near New York City. Following the storm, polar air will then spread across much of the central and eastern U.S., with temperatures well below normal by Friday. Freezing temperatures are forecast to reach the Deep South by Saturday morning, setting up a widespread frost and freeze across the South and Southeast this weekend. Is snow likely? Mostly in the mountains. The WPC said rain will turn to snow Thursday night and into Friday at higher elevations in New York, northeastern Pennsylvania and northern New England, where accumulating snow is likely. AccuWeather said Pittsburgh, Syracuse and Binghamton could see their first snowflakes of the season, along with the Poconos, Catskills and Berkshires. Wet snow is also possible in the southern and central Appalachians from Friday night into Saturday morning, the WPC said. But AccuWeather senior meteorologist Adam Douty said, "outside of higher elevations, snow should struggle to accumulate." As it stands, most coastal areas and lower-lying parts of the Northeast, including Philadelphia, New York and Boston, are more likely to see rain than snow. Areas such as North Wildwood, N.J., were hit by an unusually strong nor'easter in September. Ryan Murphy via Getty Images Is the nor'easter linked to the polar vortex? The early weakening of the polar vortex , which started last week, has left many wondering whether a blast of icy weather is on its way as a result. But forecasters have said it's not that clear. While the WPC's latest forecast refers to polar air, meaning a mass of very cold air from Canada, it doesn't mention the polar vortex. Tyler Roys, a meteorologist at AccuWeather, told Yahoo it is "hard to say if there is any connection between the two." He said most of the impacts from an early polar vortex disruption are "going towards eastern Europe and Asia." If the vortex has any influence, Roys said, it is likely tied to the cold arriving behind the storm, though "the influence of the polar vortex appears to be limited." Roys added that forecasters "do feel that there could be an increase of influence from the polar vortex towards the end of November into December" as the current pattern fades and a new one sets up. Laura Ciasto, a meteorologist at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), told Yahoo that the vortex has been "displaced for well over a week," though it hasn't yet reached the threshold for a sudden stratospheric warming, a rapid warming high in the atmosphere that can weaken or split the vortex. "It's possible we are seeing that effect at the surface now," she said. "It's a classic chicken-or-the-egg situation." What is a nor'easter? A nor'easter is a storm situated along the East Coast of the U.S., with its namesake reflecting that the winds over the coastal area are usually from the northeast, the NWS says. It forms when an area of lower air pressure draws in surrounding air and strengthens near the coast. It is often fueled by the clash of cold air from the north and warm, moist air over the Gulf Stream. While these storms can happen at any time of year, they are usually at their strongest between the colder months, from September through April. Nor'easters "nearly always" bring precipitation in the form of heavy rain or snow, the NWS says, as well as winds of gale force, rough seas and, sometimes, coastal flooding. The most violent nor'easters have caused billions of dollars in damage. The storm is expected to be less severe than September's early-season nor'easter, which killed a New York City Housing Authority worker , flooded coastal communities and left more than 130,000 customers without power across the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, the Associated Press reported. articles.title: Hegseth honors guard who scolded his group at the Tomb of Unknown Soldier
articles.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday honored the Army sentinel who forcefully scolded members of his entourage for laughing and talking near Arlington National Cemetery's Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day. Hegseth posted a photo of himself on social media pinning a Joint Service Commendation Medal on the unidentified soldier’s chest. “We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist,” Hegseth wrote. “Carry on Patriots.” On Veterans Day, Hegseth, his wife Jennifer, and three of his top deputies were seen posing for photographs on the steps overlooking the tomb, which has provided a final resting place for several of America’s unidentified service members — and a site of reflection and mourning — since 1921. Members of the group could be heard chuckling and chatting as they ascended the steps. We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist. Carry on Patriots. pic.twitter.com/Uk6ek6oOso — Secretary of War Pete Hegseth (@SecWar) November 12, 2026 The sentinel — a member of the Army’s 3rd Infantry Regiment, known as The Old Guard — stepped forward and shouted in their direction: “All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times!” Video of the encounter, which followed the annual Veterans Day wreath-laying ceremony, spread quickly online. A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier issued a verbal reprimand to a group of advisers and staffers with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth following a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery. As the group broke from taking photos, a loud laugh could be… pic.twitter.com/dIPp8wMGEG — The Associated Press (@AP) November 11, 2026 On Wednesday evening, Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell issued a statement saying the soldier had acted appropriately. “While commemorating this solemn day, a soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum,” Parnell said. Joint Service Commendation Medals are awarded to members of the Armed Forces who distinguish themselves while serving in a joint activity or on joint military staff. Hegseth’s Veterans Day flap follows his brush with impeachment earlier this week . On Tuesday, the Republican-controlled U.S. House of Representatives voted to effectively kill the articles of impeachment against Hegseth — for now — by blocking their consideration on the House floor and sending them back to the Judiciary Committee, where GOP leaders can hold them up until the next Congress is seated in January 2027. Rep. Thomas Massie, a Republican from Kentucky, reintroduced impeachment charges against Hegseth on Monday, alleging that the embattled Pentagon chief had committed "high crimes and misdemeanors" and abused the power of his office by violating the War Powers Resolution, conducting military operations without congressional authorization and ordering unlawful military actions in several countries. Democrats — who voted unanimously against shelving the impeachment charges — will have a large House majority next year after winning at least 255 seats in last week's midterm elections. They have already vowed to try to remove Hegseth from office when they take control of Congress, building on voter dissatisfaction with the war in Iran. "In the majority, one of the first things we're gonna do is run Pete Hegseth out of town," Democratic Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the minority leader who is poised to become House speaker, said at a rally last month . Hegseth would be just the third Cabinet official in U.S. history to be impeached , and the second in three years. articles.title: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman explains the 'paradox' of AI for his company
articles.summary: Reddit ( RDDT ) is one of the most frequently cited sources in AI-generated answers. Yet its most recent earnings report showed that Google's AI Overviews have undermined its search traffic. At Yahoo Finance Invest , Reddit co-founder and CEO Steve Huffman described this dynamic as the "paradox" of AI for the company. "AI does not exist as we know it without Reddit, " Huffman said on Thursday. "Every model you've heard of trained with or without our permission using Reddit. It's this paradox which is the more AI there is, the more the human nature of Reddit stands out." In a quarterly letter to investors in October, Huffman noted that Reddit's search traffic "dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per week" during the month. "Web search is evolving from a gateway to the web to becoming an AI-powered destination itself," Huffman said. Huffman added in the company's third quarter earnings call that "Google is not sending [users] to Reddit the way they used to." According to Similarweb, a web analytics platform, Reddit's traffic is down 13% year over year. Reddit's $60 million-a-year data deal with Google is up for renewal next year. The company's Q3 report showed total daily active unique users increased 12% year over year to 130.3 million (slightly below analyst expectations of 133.7 million), while US daily active users declined 2% year over year. While the company beat earnings per share estimates, it came up short on its Q4 revenue forecast, predicting sales of $1.0 billion to $1.03 billion (slightly below some Wall Street consensus estimates near $1.05 billion). Huffman told Yahoo Finance that Reddit will begin testing a requirement for users to log in to access content on the platform in the United States starting this quarter. "We are not the first," Huffman said, speaking about other social media platforms. "In fact, we are quite literally the last company to go through this transition." He added that the company, however, does not want to wall itself off from the open web — whether that's humans or AI. The ethos driving Reddit, Huffman explained, is that "Reddit is for humans." The platform is all about "questions that have no answers." "'What should I watch tonight?' There's not a factual answer for that — there's just 100 answers. And all of those answers have a different point of view and context," Huffman said. "People like the different perspectives. They like the mess. They like the chaos — that's what being human is." This article originally appeared on Yahoo Finance at https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/reddit-ceo-steve-huffman-explains-the-paradox-of-ai-for-his-company-162654170.html

articles.title: Senators investigate whether RFK Jr. lied to Congress about his 2019 Samoa trip
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Two Democratic senators are launching an investigation into whether Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. lied to Congress about his reason for a 2019 trip to Samoa after The Associated Press and The Guardian published documents in August refuting his testimony . The new inquiry is one of a vast array of investigations planned into the Trump administration after Democrats regained control of the House and Senate from Republicans in the midterm elections. Sens. Ron Wyden, D-Ore., and Angela Alsobrooks, D-Md., said in a letter Wednesday to Children's Health Defense, a nonprofit group known for anti-vaccine activism that was formerly chaired by Kennedy, that they were starting an investigation. The lawmakers asked the group for a broad range of documents related to Kennedy's Samoa travel, his 2024 presidential campaign and his Senate confirmation process. The letter also requested all communications between the group and federal government officials since President Donald Trump's second term began in January 2025. The senators gave the group a deadline of Dec. 4 to comply. AP and Guardian reporting in August showed that while Kennedy repeatedly told lawmakers who held the key to his confirmation last year that his visit to Samoa before a deadly measles outbreak had "nothing to do with vaccines," a letter he sent to the Samoan prime minister ahead of the trip on Children's Health Defense letterhead showed otherwise. In the letter, Kennedy used the words vaccine or vaccination eight times. "We intend to hold Secretary Kennedy accountable for the grave harm he has caused to vulnerable children," Wyden and Alsobrooks wrote in their letter. "We also intend to hold him accountable for any false statements made to Congress, a crime that undermines the Senate's ability to fulfill its constitutional duties." The Department of Health and Human Services has maintained that the Samoa visit "was unrelated to vaccines." In response to an AP inquiry in August, it said "any claim or insinuation based on these letters that Secretary Kennedy lied under oath or to Congress is not only false but outright defamatory." Kennedy was not under oath during his confirmation hearing. Knowingly giving material false testimony to Congress is a crime that carries a possible prison sentence regardless of whether a person is under oath, though it is rarely prosecuted. Spokespeople for Children's Health Defense and HHS did not immediately respond to requests for comment Thursday. Wyden is expected to chair the Senate Finance Committee, which has oversight into Kennedy's health department, when Democrats retake Congress in January. Alsobrooks serves on the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee, which also oversees the department. The same senators on Wednesday announced a separate investigation into hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of gifts reportedly given last year to Kennedy by a donor and former employee. This article originally appeared on Associated Press at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/senators-probe-rfk-jr-account-161058538.html

articles.title: Trump says 'we don't need a deal with Iran' and that Vance should focus on Democrats
articles.summary: By Bo Erickson WASHINGTON, Nov 12 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump said on Thursday the US does not need a deal with Iran and directed Vice President JD Vance, who has played ‌a role in efforts to resolve the war, to focus "his complete and total attention" ‌on alleged crime and corruption in Democratic-run cities and states. Trump's directive came a day after the Wall Street Journal ​reported that Vance was considering face-to-face peace talks with a hard-line Iranian security official and a week after the vice president blamed the costly war with Iran for Republicans' midterm elections drubbing. Trump's comments marked a shift in tone after he had suggested in recent weeks that Iran would be ‌more willing to strike a deal ⁠in the eight-month conflict after the US elections. "We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We've got their money, Hundreds ⁠of Billions of Dollars, and we've got their Strait!" Trump wrote on social media, referring to the Strait of Hormuz, the critical shipping route near Iran where the US military has been working to ​secure ​safe passage for international shipping. Trump said he asked Vance ​to focus instead on a domestic ‌issue the president previously put in his portfolio: leading an effort targeting alleged fraud in Democratic-run cities and states throughout the US. "Our Budget could be quickly BALANCED with the correction of this large-scale criminal activity. CORRUPTION is in the Democrat Leadership's blood!" Trump wrote on Thursday. Vance's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday that Vance ‌was considering meeting with a senior Iranian security official, ​a move that would have put Vance at the center of ​peace negotiations. Reuters has not confirmed ​the potential talks. Vance, who is viewed as a leading contender for the 2028 ‌Republican presidential nomination, distanced himself from the war ​last week after Republicans' ​midterm election rout by Democrats. The vice president blamed the costs of the Iran war in part for the party's losses. He also said an earlier recommendation to end the ​war was "sound advice." Trump responded to ‌Vance's position by defending the war as necessary to stop Iran from obtaining a ​nuclear weapon. (Reporting by Doina Chiacu, Susan Heavey, and Bo Erickson in Washington; Editing ​by Tomasz Janowski, Colleen Jenkins and Andrea Ricci ) This article originally appeared on Reuters at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-says-vance-focus-domestic-133908907.html

articles.title: Planning Nvidia probes, top Democrats tell administration to 'preserve all records'
articles.summary: Democratic Sens. Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts and Chris Coons of Delaware have formally asked the Trump administration to "preserve all records" related to the administration's dealings with Nvidia ( NVDA ) as Democrats prepare to take power on Capitol Hill in 2027 and promise to probe the issues surrounding CEO Jensen Huang's departure. The request came in a letter Wednesday evening targeting any administration materials related to the chipmaker's exports to China, as well as the ousted CEO's affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. Huang's resignation "does not absolve him, other executives, or the company as a whole of responsibility for putting our national security at risk or for any potential violations of our laws," Warren said in a statement Thursday morning adding that Trump officials must still "explain why they have not closed export control loopholes." The letter was directed to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and White House chief of staff Stephen Miller and noted reports that Trump officials were aware of concerns about Nvidia, "yet did not move to block the continued flow of advanced AI chips to Megaspeed or other companies affiliated with the suspected operative." The White House didn't offer an immediate response Thursday morning. The letter asked the officials to confirm by next Tuesday that they will comply and have begun the document preservation process. Huang stepped down as CEO on Thursday as the scandal over his extramarital affairs quickly besieged one of the world's most valuable companies and its founder. Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick speak in the Oval Office of the White House in July. (AP Photo/Julia Demaree Nikhinson) AP Photo/Julia Demaree Nikhinson A likely focus on Lutnick Warren and Coons are in line to be the heads of the Senate's powerful Banking and Foreign Relations committees and will oversee any investigations with subpoena power. Meanwhile, the still-unfolding scandal has multiple prongs that touch the White House and the Trump administration. Huang lobbied President Trump to loosen limits on advanced chips, and the White House allowed Nvidia to ship certain versions to China and other countries deemed security risks. Trump reportedly didn't take action when he learned about the possibility of a security breach and has repeatedly defended Huang in recent days, calling him "an honorable guy." Sen. Elizabeth Warren is seen on Capitol Hill this summer. (Andrew Harnik/Getty Images) Andrew Harnik via Getty Images Axios reported that Trump last week ordered a crackdown on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia's advanced AI chips to China, but that it was Lutnick who stood in the way and at least slow-walked the order's execution. That turned the focus on Lutnick, who will be under perhaps the most direct scrutiny in the months ahead. Ruben Gallego, another Democratic senator and potential 2028 presidential candidate, wrote on X that Lutnick "sold out our national security to keep the stock market high." Lutnick has also drawn scrutiny from Trump allies. "Secretary Lutnick needs to answer [why he chose to allow the sales of advanced chips] in front of God and country," Republican Sen. John Kennedy of Louisiana told Politico . Steve Bannon, who served as the White House's chief strategist in the first Trump administration, recently said, "We are going to have to get to the bottom of what happened at Commerce." Letters asking for preservation of documents are a standard first step as investigations ramp up. In their letter, Warren and Coons said publicly available information "raises significant concerns about the federal government's ability to effectively enforce our export controls and protect our national security." The senators also requested a congressional briefing on possible national security risks. This story has been updated. Ben Werschkul is a Washington correspondent for Yahoo Finance. articles.title: U.S. envoys arrive at Kremlin for Putin meeting after Ukraine talks
articles.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were in Moscow after two days of talks in Abu Dhabi (Vyacheslav PROKOFYEV) Vladimir Putin indicated Thursday that Russia will not compromise on its hardline demands to end the Ukraine offensive, but offered a short-term ceasefire in a key frontline city during a Kremlin meeting with US envoys. The Russian president said he would not water down his territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine that Russia claims to have annexed, and ruled out agreeing to foreign peacekeeping troops being stationed in Ukraine -- a deployment that he said would be a "continuation of war". Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were in Moscow after two days of talks in Abu Dhabi searching for a way to end Europe's worst conflict since World War II. Putin's comments appeared to douse hopes that a deal to end the war could be within grasp, after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said there was a "window of opportunity" to achieve "a result" before 2027. The Americans, meanwhile, urged Putin to allow European representatives to sit at the table for the next round of talks. Moscow has successfully managed to reframe the discussions on the war as part of a wider discussion about European security. But Kyiv and European leaders have urged against a new "Yalta" -- a reference to the post-WWII deal to carve the continent into spheres of influence -- and said talks must be focused on ending the Ukraine war first. Kushner and Witkoff will travel to Dublin, where a European summit is taking place, to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky later on Thursday. - 'Continuation of war' - Usually held behind closed doors, the Kremlin chose to televise a lengthy opening exchange between Putin and the US envoys. The Russian leader rejected talk of a possible territorial settlement involving "grey" -- or demilitarised -- zones between Ukrainian and Russian positions. "For us, there is only one line of demarcation: the state border. Because then it will be clear and obvious: here are we, and here are you," he said. Russia has seized swathes of eastern and southern Ukraine since launching its full-scale offensive in 2022. That is in addition to Crimea, which it annexed in 2014, and territory that was under the control of Russian-backed separatists. Moscow has formally annexed four regions of Ukraine -- Donetsk, Kherson, Lugansk and Zaporizhzhia -- despite not having full control over them. The annexations are rejected by Kyiv and the West as illegal and not recognised by the international community. Advances by Russia's army have slowed throughout 2026 and hundreds of thousands have been killed in the almost five-year conflict, with millions more forced to flee their homes. Putin proposed organising what he called a "humanitarian mission" to the frontline city of Kostyantynivka, where he said some 400-500 civilians still lived. Russia claimed in the summer to have captured the city, but Ukraine insists fighting is ongoing for control. The idea would be modelled on a short-term truce that last month allowed hundreds of stranded and starving locals to flee the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine. Putin also repeated his long-standing objection to any foreign troops being deployed to Ukraine as a post-war peacekeeping force -- something Kyiv says is crucial to thwarting another Russian attack. Moscow would see any foreign troops deployed in the country as a "legitimate target," Putin said, adding their deployment would be a "vicious circle" and mean "the continuation of war". - 'United vision' - European countries have been rattled by Russia pushing a review of the entire continent's security architecture, with the US also floating a new framework. That is widely seen as a reference to Moscow's long-standing demands to push back the NATO military alliance in eastern Europe and end Western military support to Kyiv. Some 50 European leaders gathered in the Irish capital Thursday, where EU chief Antonio Costa said "there is no need to reinvent the wheel" on Europe's security framework as he accused Russia of wrecking it by attacking Ukraine. French President Emmanuel Macron meanwhile urged Europe to rally behind a "clear and united vision" on what it wants from Ukraine talks. Russia and the United States are pushing Europe to name a single representative who they can deal with. Amid the talks, the death and destruction continued. Overnight, Russian strikes hit a residential building in Kyiv, killing one person. In Putin's home city of Saint Petersburg, a car bomb blast killed a Russian soldier -- the latest in a string of apparent assassinations of military figures inside Russia. Zelensky also reported fresh restrictions had been placed on the Starshield satellite internet service, key to Ukraine's front line communications. bur/phz This article originally appeared on AFP at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/us-mediated-talks-russia-ukraine-025843578.html

articles.title: Nebius Q3业绩超预期，资本开支升至270亿美元、ARR目标延期，股价盘前跌逾14% | 财报见闻
articles.summary: AI云计算公司Nebius Group公布第三季度业绩，营收与利润双双超出市场预期，但ARR增长指引下调与资本开支大幅上调的组合，令投资者对其盈利路径产生疑虑，股价盘前一度跌逾14%。 Nebius三季度营收达9.81亿美元，较市场预期的9.19亿美元高出约6.7%；调整后EBITDA为4.66亿美元，亦大幅超出预期的3.57亿美元。 然而，公司将年化经常性收入（ARR）目标从此前承诺的"2026年12月前达到70亿至90亿美元"下调至"2027年2月前达到70亿美元以上"，与此同时，公司还表示"ARR不再是衡量业务的正确指标"， 令外界对其战略方向的清晰度产生质疑。 值得注意的是，同日半导体领域亦出现普遍抛售情绪，CoreWeave盘前同样下跌约10%，部分市场参与者认为Nebius此次个股跌幅与更广泛的板块情绪共振，难以完全剥离。 营收与利润均超预期，规模扩张步伐显著加速 三季度，Nebius实现营收9.81亿美元，同比增长571%；调整后EBITDA为4.66亿美元，相比去年同期的亏损520万美元实现大幅扭转。前三季度累计营收为19.62亿美元，同比增长549%；累计调整后EBITDA为8.32亿美元。 运营成本方面，三季度总运营成本及费用为9.30亿美元，低于分析师预期的11.6亿美元，显示出一定的成本管控能力。其中折旧与摊销费用达3.55亿美元，占营收比例约36%，反映出公司资产基础的快速积累。 三季度资本开支约为73亿美元，期末现金及现金等价物为74.26亿美元。按GAAP口径，三季度持续经营业务净亏损为3750万美元，但调整后净利润为9090万美元。 指引更新：2027年收入目标维持，资本开支大幅上调 Nebius维持2026年全年营收将落于30亿至34亿美元区间低端的预期，并首次给出2027年营收指引——预计达到120亿至130亿美元。 然而令市场关注的是资本开支规模的大幅上调。 公司将2026年资本开支指引从此前的200亿至250亿美元上调至约270亿美元；2027年资本开支则规划在400亿至450亿美元之间，用于支持新增超过1 GW的算力容量建设。 这一规模的持续投入意味着公司在中期内自由现金流将承受较大压力。 公司同步将ARR目标节点从"2026年12月"延后至"2027年2月"，目标区间下沿亦从70亿美元收窄为"70亿美元以上"，且公司暗示未来或将采用其他指标替代ARR来衡量业务进展，这一表态进一步增加了外界对业绩追踪可比性的不确定性。 资产负债表快速扩张，融资活动规模庞大 截至2026年9月30日，Nebius总资产达387.44亿美元，较2025年年底的124.30亿美元增长逾两倍，主要驱动来自物业及设备净值的快速扩张——该科目期末达124.31亿美元。 前三季度，公司通过融资活动净获现金约166.18亿美元，其中包括57.50亿美元可转换票据发行收益、38.09亿美元国库股出售所得，以及7.73亿美元长期借款。与此同时，投资活动现金流出达159.24亿美元，主要为购置物业及设备支出。 截至报告期末，公司总股本为292,902,405股，其中A类股259,597,352股，B类股33,305,053股，另有29,138,539股A类库存股不计入流通。 业务构成：AI云为核心，多元布局并行 Nebius定位为面向开发者和企业的全栈AI云平台，覆盖从数据处理、模型训练到生产部署的完整链条，服务于全球范围内构建AI产品、智能体及服务的初创公司与大型企业。 除核心AI云业务外，集团旗下还包括自动驾驶及配送机器人开发商Avride、科技职业再培训教育平台TripleTen，以及在ClickHouse和Toloka的股权投资。其中，Toloka自2025年第二季度完成第三方投资交易后，Nebius已不再持有其多数表决权，该业务已从合并报表中剥离并计入权益法投资。 创始人兼首席执行官Arkady Volozh已就三季度业绩发布致股东季度公开信，并于美东时间11月12日上午8时主持业绩电话会议。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。

articles.summary: 伊朗最高安全官员发出迄今最强硬的军事警告，将潜在打击目标范围扩大至欧洲境内的美军基地，令中东局势紧张态势进一步向外蔓延，并对全球能源市场构成新的不确定性压力。 据央视新闻12日报道，伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊（Mohsen Rezaei）在11月11日播出的采访中表示，如果美国再次对伊朗发动军事打击，伊朗将把打击范围扩大至欧洲境内的美军基地。他明确警告： "如果美国军机从欧洲国家的美军基地起飞轰炸伊朗，我们也将打击那些基地。"雷扎伊同时否认伊朗正与美国进行任何谈判，称相关报道是"谎言"，并强调在伊方七项条件得到满足之前，霍尔木兹海峡将继续关闭。 上述表态令市场对中东局势的风险溢价预期升温。霍尔木兹海峡是全球重要的石油运输通道，伊朗持续关闭该海峡已对国际油价形成支撑。雷扎伊此番将打击目标延伸至欧洲，进一步加剧了市场对冲突扩大化的担忧，也使美伊之间本已脆弱的外交斡旋前景更趋复杂。 周四油价延续回调趋势，布油逼近90美元关口。 打击范围升级，欧洲美军基地被列入目标 雷扎伊在采访中系统阐述了伊朗潜在的军事反应层级：首先打击附近所有美军基地，其次打击此前尚未攻击过的远程美军基地，最后甚至可能打击"美方认为伊朗导弹无法触及的岛屿"。 他表示， 伊朗的打击能力"远超战争第一天"，并称伊朗导弹射程已覆盖此前被认为超出其能力范围的目标。 伊朗媒体此前列出的潜在打击目标包括位于塞浦路斯、希腊、罗马尼亚、阿尔巴尼亚、意大利和英国的美军及北约军事设施，以及美英在印度洋迪戈加西亚岛共同运营的军事基地。 不过，伊朗是否具备实际打击上述目标的能力，目前仍存争议。美国战略与国际问题研究中心（CSIS）的资料显示， 伊朗主要弹道导弹射程约为2000公里，部分型号可能达到3000公里 。英国皇家联合军种国防研究所则表示， 从理论上讲，伊朗具备打击英国境内目标的可能性。 值得注意的是， 在上述警告发布前数日，美国军方已将部分空中加油机和军机从英国东部的米尔登霍尔皇家空军基地撤离，约10架KC-135加油机和3架"鱼鹰"倾转旋翼机被转移至德国、西班牙及英国其他基地，此举被认为与潜在安全威胁有关。 强硬表态背后：打击范围的逐步扩大 雷扎伊在采访中梳理了伊朗军事行动的演变轨迹，以此为此次警告提供背景支撑。他表示，在2025年6月持续12天的战争中，伊朗将打击范围限制在以色列境内；而在2月28日爆发的本轮战争中，伊朗已对中东地区多个美国军事基地发动袭击；如今，伊朗官员开始公开将欧洲列入潜在打击范围。 上个月，伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊曾下令武装部队做好"即时、有力、不受地理范围限制"的报复准备，并要求全面更新目标数据库，将所有美国和以色列资产纳入打击范围。伊朗军方发言人随后声明称，下一场战争可能蔓延至"西亚以外地区"。 否认谈判，外交前景蒙上阴影 雷扎伊的强硬表态与近期有关美伊外交接触升温的报道形成直接矛盾。 他明确否认伊朗正与美国进行任何谈判，并将有关双方计划在卡塔尔举行会晤、或他本人 将与美国副总统万斯会面的报道 斥为"谎言"，称这些消息旨在"缓解经济压力并压低国际油价"。当被直接问及是否计划与万斯会面时，他回答："绝对没有。" 然而，据媒体报道， 万斯近期在对伊外交中扮演的角色已超过特使Steve Witkoff和Jared Kushner。 万斯于10月向雷扎伊发出信函，请求安排会面，多哈被视为下一阶段谈判的可能举办地。 万斯上周还会见了卡塔尔首相，特朗普称此次会面"非常出色"。 据央视新闻12日报道，伊朗议会议长卡利巴夫表示，伊朗已向美方给出了明确且直白的答复，阐述了伊朗的正当诉求。 核问题与霍尔木兹：伊朗坚守红线 在核问题上，雷扎伊态度同样强硬。 据新华社周三报道，雷扎伊表示， 伊朗不会让一点浓缩铀运出境。 伊方已告知俄罗斯，浓缩铀将留在伊朗境内供自己使用。伊朗需要用浓缩铀设计以核能为动力的船舶和潜艇。 在霍尔木兹海峡问题上，雷扎伊重申，美国必须全面满足伊方提出的七项条件，海峡方可重开。 他表示，伊方首要条件是结束所有战线上的战争，尤其是黎巴嫩战事，并称美国最初的回应具有"欺骗性"。雷扎伊还声称，在此前一轮于伊斯兰堡举行的谈判中，伊美双方曾签署一项协议，但特朗普在不到一个月后便撕毁了协议。 霍尔木兹海峡持续关闭对全球原油供应构成直接威胁。雷扎伊此番将打击目标延伸至欧洲、同时否认谈判进展的表态，令市场对局势缓和的预期再度降温，油价走势将继续受到美伊关系动向的密切牵引。 风险提示及免责条款 市场有风险，投资需谨慎。本文不构成个人投资建议，也未考虑到个别用户特殊的投资目标、财务状况或需要。用户应考虑本文中的任何意见、观点或结论是否符合其特定状况。据此投资，责任自负。

articles.title: 百度想重构大模型调度的入口
articles.summary: 11月12日的百度世界大会上，李彦宏谈起了大模型市场里的一门常见的生意——中转站的商业痛点。 “这些中转站它们把各种模型提供方聚合起来，提供给开发者来调用，但它们并不对模型的效果、服务的稳定性、响应速度等负责，甚至有时候这个模型的真实性都无从考证，它如果说用一个flash来代替，或者它生成一个Pro版本基本上也不会在中转站遇到什么阻力。” 模型厂商和第三方推理服务商越来越多，同一款模型往往有多个供应渠道，价格和服务表现各不相同，增加了开发者的选型成本。一批中转平台由此出现，通过聚合模型资源、提供统一接口，向开发者出售调用服务。 针对这一痛点，百度推出了自己的大模型交易平台词元所。词元所产品经理尤莉给出的解释是：“词元所是一个中立、可信的大模型交易平台，连接供给方与消费方，抹平双方之间的信息差。让词元的交易像交易上市公司的股票一样方便、公开和透明。” 本次百度世界大会上，百度披露词元所上线一个月以来，已有超过100个供应资源入驻，日均调用次数超过5000万次，日均调用Token超过7000亿。 词元所想做的，是把分散在不同渠道的模型调用资源，集中到一个能够比价、查看运行数据和信用评级的平台上。 对模型供应商而言，它是接触开发者的销售渠道；对开发者和企业客户而言，它是集中寻找、比较和采购模型服务的入口。 对百度来说，聚合模型资源只是开始，吸引供需双方持续在平台上交易，才是这门生意的关键。 从中转站到交易平台 在词元所，同一款模型的调用服务可以由多家供应商提供。 用户购买的对象，是特定供应商在一定价格、性能和可用性条件下提供的模型调用服务，模型本身不在交易范围之内。 这意味着模型名称相同，用户实际获得的服务也可能不同。 截至11月12日，平台官网模型市场展示40余款模型，覆盖DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱GLM、MiniMax等主流模型与视频模型，百度自家的文心系列也在其中。 词元所官网供应商列表显示，不少供应商的入驻日期集中在9月18日至23日，11月初也有新的入驻记录。 针对同一款模型，各家供应商给出的价格也不同。 以DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为例，五家供应资源输出token报价从每百万2.96元至6.00元不等，首token延迟从951毫秒到2114毫秒不等。 过去，开发者如果想比较不同渠道的报价和服务表现，往往需要分别查找供应商、查看报价或测试接口。词元所整合这些信息，便于开发者寻找和初步筛选供应商。 对尚未建立模型供应渠道的新用户来说，这种便利可能比统一API本身更有吸引力。 从词元所官网供应商排行榜来看，不同供应商获得的调用量差距悬殊。截至11月12日，博川科技近7天调用量约4.21亿次，北京心智无限约326.8万次，两者相差约129倍。部分供应商同期调用量不足万次。 词元所把不同供应商的报价、性能指标和调用数据集中展示，让开发者可以在同一平台比较服务，也让供应商直接面对其他服务商的竞争。 不过，供应商入驻和交易规模增长是两回事。博川科技在榜单上的调用量远高于其他供应商，但原有客户贡献与平台新增交易难以根据现有数据划分。 聚合供应资源只是第一步，百度需要吸引客户持续在平台上采购，才能把模型展示入口变成实际交易市场。 入口补位 在原有千帆MaaS业务之外，百度通过词元所增加了一个面向多家模型供应商的交易平台。 百度集团执行副总裁、百度智能云事业群总裁沈抖在大会上介绍：“我们提供了两类模型服务。第一类，我们作为模型服务商，提供极致性价比的MaaS服务。第二类，是词元所。它的特点是中立、可信，为所有的Token提供方和需求方提供对接的平台。” 企业可以通过百度原有的MaaS渠道获取模型服务，也可以通过词元所比较、采购不同供应商的模型调用资源。 这一安排与百度已有的云业务有关。沈抖在演讲中对智能云的定位是：“传统的云服务的是企业IT系统，支撑企业各类软件、应用上云。现在，智能云要进一步去支撑智能体去完成一个一个的任务。” 模型交易平台需要同时吸引供应商和采购方。 供应商越多，开发者能够比较的模型资源、价格和服务方案就越丰富；采购方越多，供应商入驻平台、提供优惠报价和稳定服务的动力也会增加。 这种供需相互吸引的关系，是交易平台扩大规模的重要条件。百度可以借助已有云客户形成初始需求，再用更多第三方模型资源吸引新的开发者。如果交易增加，平台也有机会吸引更多供应商加入。 但在模型调用市场，买卖双方通常不是一对一的绑定关系。供应商可以同时接入其他云平台和中转服务，开发者也可以通过多个渠道调用同一款模型。 词元所即使聚合了大量资源，也不意味着这些供应商和客户会独家留在百度。 百度2026年第二季度财报显示，AI云基础设施收入为73亿元，同比增长50%；AI应用收入为25亿元，同比增长3%。 对已经使用百度云的企业来说，随着AI应用增加，调用的模型未必只有百度文心，还可能包括DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi等第三方模型。词元所支持百度账号登录、充值和API调用，已经在用百度云的企业因此多了一个在百度体系内采购第三方模型调用服务的选项。 如果企业原有的采购、权限和结算体系能够一并复用，切换成本会更低，目前难以确认可复用的程度。 词元所为百度增加了一个承接多模型需求的渠道，它一方面承接百度原有云客户的多模型采购需求，另一方面通过统一的模型货架、报价和信用评价吸引更多开发者。 百度的优势首先来自已有云业务。如果企业原有的账户、采购和结算体系能与词元所打通，新增第三方模型调用可能减少重新接入其他平台的工作。 但这种优势并非百度独有。各家大型云服务商同样拥有企业客户、模型服务平台和成熟的计费体系，也可以通过聚合第三方模型承接客户需求。统一API、模型展示和计费功能本身，其他多模型服务平台也可以应用。 交易收入则是另一项需要验证的商业回报。 这次百度世界大会上，李彦宏表示：“今年初，一度强调token maxing的企业，也纷纷掉头开始控制这方面的预算。” 词元所尚未公开具体的抽佣、加价或服务收费方式，现有调用量也不能直接换算成平台收入。除了交易本身，百度还可能通过词元所接触新的开发者和企业客户，将模型采购需求引向千帆、智能体及其他云服务，但目前没有公开的新增客户、付费和业务转化数据。 信用评价之外 针对选型难题，词元所给出两类工具。 第一类是验真，对应供应商入驻环节。平台对模型提供方做资质来源核验，对模型资源做全面准入测试，覆盖模型指纹比对、能力测试、性能测试、可用性测试与容量压测，百度希望借此识别模型冒用、参数虚标等问题。 第二类是征信，主要针对模型上线后的服务表现。词元所产品经理尤莉在发布会上举例，有客户接入模型资源时服务表现良好，使用一段时间后出现异常，直到终端用户投诉才发现问题。 按照百度的介绍，模型资源上架后，平台会持续监测服务质量，定期抽检，展示实际调用中的运行指标，对供应商在服务质量、兑现度、安全合规、商业履约等维度打分并形成信用评级标签，数据沉淀为公开可查的信用档案。 不过，企业通过词元所购买第三方模型服务，还需要考虑稳定性。 词元所11月11日更新的服务协议提到，对于平台自身的网关、鉴权服务，百度承诺尽合理商业努力保障稳定；对于第三方供应商的故障、网络波动、模型能力退化及下线等情况，协议约定平台不承担相应的违约赔偿责任。 协议还明确，百度对供应商披露信息进行形式核验，并不代表为供应商的实际行为提供担保。 对于平台依据协议需要承担的赔偿责任，服务协议设定了累计赔偿上限，不超过用户过去12个月实际支付的服务费。同时，协议建议用户在业务侧做多模型资源容灾降级方案。 换句话说，百度愿意承担模型资源的检测、展示和信用管理工作，但并未因此承诺为第三方模型的全部服务质量兜底。 承担质量管理工作与向客户提供质量担保，在合同上是两回事。 百度称，供应商信用下降时，平台会主动提醒用户，但公开资料尚未说明信用降级后的排序调整、接单限制、资源下架及纠纷处理规则。 对百度而言，信用评价有机会成为模型交易平台的差异化能力，但能否形成持续的竞争优势，还要看它能在多大程度上影响客户选择和供应商行为。 词元所已经有了供应资源和调用规模，接下来需要证明的，是这些交易能为百度带来多少新增客户、收入和利润。 风险提示及免责条款
